name: AnotherPrince ~Ushinawareta Monogatari~
source:
In a world of lost fairy tales, a handsome man calls himself "Cinderella"!?

A collection of old fairy tales found at the library where I work.
"Cinderella", "The Little Mermaid", "Rapunzel" ...
When you turn the page, there are many fairy tales that you know well.
――All stories are blank from the middle
And the Princess is depicted as "Prince"-

The "new story" given to the princes and the secret of the hidden "curse of blood"
The story does not end.
They still have something left to do.
It's up to you what kind of story to spin on a blank page

-Now, turn the page.
Welcome to a world full of love and tragedy.
translation:
在失落的童话世界中，一位俊美男子竟自称“灰姑娘”！？

在我工作的图书馆里，发现了一本古老的童话集。
《灰姑娘》《海的女儿》《长发姑娘》……
翻开书页，尽是那些耳熟能详的童话。
——然而，所有故事写到中途，后面便一片空白。
而其中的公主，全被描绘成了“王子”——

等待王子们的“新故事”，以及暗藏的“血之诅咒”的秘密。
故事尚未结束。
他们还有未竟之事。
要在空白书页上编织怎样的故事，全由你决定。

——现在，翻开书页吧。
欢迎来到这个爱与悲剧交织的世界。
